decisions.subject: Preview creative direction

options_considered.label: Problem-to-solution product reveal
options_considered.reason: Strongest short-form product introduction using currently available stills.

options_considered.label: Quick installation overview
options_considered.reason: Useful but needs careful treatment to avoid implying unverified hands-on demonstration.

options_considered.label: Buyer-fit reality check
options_considered.reason: High trust and strong limitations, but more suitable as a follow-up buyer guide.

decisions.reason: User explicitly approved all three concepts (C1, C2, and C3) as retained creative directions and confirmed C1 as the first preview to render.

decisions.subject: Native render runtime

options_considered.label: Remotion
options_considered.reason: Composer dependencies are present in CI and fit a React-based product composition.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames
options_considered.reason: Doctor reported optional/runtime issues and it is not the selected engine for this hybrid composition.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg concat
options_considered.reason: Useful for the existing smoke test but not the intended native OpenMontage composition pipeline.

decisions.reason: User explicitly approved Remotion as the native render runtime for this preview.

decisions.subject: Composition authoring mode

options_considered.label: Templated composition
options_considered.reason: Appropriate for a short, repeatable product preview using existing source stills and established components.

options_considered.label: Atelier composition
options_considered.reason: Offers a bespoke visual language but adds authoring scope not needed to prove this integration.

decisions.reason: User explicitly approved templated composition for this preview.

decisions.subject: External asset and service spend

options_considered.label: Existing assets only; $0
options_considered.reason: Uses the product images already in the Amazon Video Agent project and avoids paid services.

options_considered.label: Generate new media
options_considered.reason: Not required for this test and would introduce cost and additional review.

decisions.reason: The user-approved test configuration is silent visual-only and zero-cost.

decisions.subject: Music and sound

options_considered.label: Add music
options_considered.reason: Outside the approved silent test configuration.

decisions.reason: Silent visual-only test; no audio generation or mixing.

decisions.subject: Motion level for preview

options_considered.label: Restrained motion on stills
options_considered.reason: A subtle pan/zoom and simple transitions are sufficient for a short native renderer proof.

options_considered.label: New moving footage
options_considered.reason: Not necessary for the current integration test and not available as confirmed source media.

decisions.reason: User explicitly approved restrained pan/zoom motion on existing product stills.
